high_level_description: This image captures a cozy and inviting breakfast or brunch setting at what appears to be a café or restaurant. The focus is on a plate of food that includes two slices of avocado toast topped with sesame seeds, a poached egg, and a side salad with greens and possibly some pickled vegetables. The avocado toast looks fresh and vibrant, with the green color of the avocado contrasting nicely against the golden brown of the toast. In the background, there is a small bowl containing what seems to be granola or muesli with a dollop of jam or fruit spread on top.
